subject: Superintendent Contract Negotiations
overview: The committee convened to enter an executive session to discuss contract negotiations for the Superintendent of Schools. Members voted to enter the session and confirmed they would adjourn directly from it without returning to public session.

items.title: Opening Ceremonies
items.summary: The committee opened the meeting with a roll call and the Pledge of Allegiance.

items.title: Executive Session for Superintendent Contract Negotiations
items.summary: Approved the motion to enter executive session to conduct strategy and preparation for contract negotiations with the Superintendent of Schools.
